notes: §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR6 a: sense the break, 'Enable the control footing USE procedures and control footing SOURCE clauses to access the control data item values' the break was detected with, process footings minor to major and headings major to minor up to the break level; b: GENERATE data-name processes the detail, GENERATE report-name performs 'certain of the steps' of a detail (§1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR11, 'These steps are performed as though a GENERATE data-name statement were being executed'). GenerateCore, DetectBreakLevel, SaveCurrentRestorePriors and ProcessControlFootings do a; WithPageGroupControlValues (DialectBehavior.ControlFootingPageGroupsSeePriorControlValues inactive at 85, PB5128) gives a page group that a CF's page advance reaches the CURRENT values (§1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR13c). Probes at --std 85 (classes a-f where they reach): the witness's two-level breaks match; a CF whose page advance runs the page footing's USE procedure shows USE CF SEES A1 then USE PF SEES B2 (2023 prints A1: the edition arm works); an S9(18) control going 999999999999999999 to -999999999999999999 to 0 breaks each time, an alphanumeric group control after MOVE 'B' over 'B ' does not, minor CF before major; GENERATE of a CF (COBOL0899) and GENERATE. are refused. DEFECT (b): GENERATE report-name of a one-detail report does not execute the detail's USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure, which GR11 b requires before step d stops the presentation. kb/Work PB5337 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read4/rd-01.json).

A 1985 page footing SOURCE naming a control item prints a different value when a control footing forces the page advance.
